#FULL data
##Construct CE/NON-CE list
```{r}
cea.list=read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/full_CEA_Windows.csv")
cea.list=cea.list[,-c(1,5)]
cea.list=cea.list %>%
  mutate(CE_number=1:nrow(cea.list))
cea.list=cea.list[,c(4,3,1,2)]

movie_list=data.frame(unique(cea.list$video))#Make a reference list of videos
names(movie_list)[1]="video"
movie_list$length=c(124,78,68,95,75,112,67,167,92) #+1s to accommodate last second pause
```

```{r}
#Construct non-CE events as the interval between two CEs
nonce.list=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
  temp=cea.list %>% filter(video==movie_list[i,1]) #Select video
  nonCE=data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(temp)+1,ncol=4))
  names(nonCE)=c("nonCE_number","video","event_start","event_end")
  nonCE$nonCE_number=c(1:nrow(nonCE))
  nonCE$video=rep(movie_list[i,1],nrow(nonCE))
  
  #The first non-CE event (0 - first CE)
  nonCE[1,'event_start']=0
  nonCE[1,'event_end']=temp[1,'event_start']-0.01
  
  #The last non-CE event (last CE - end)
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_start']=temp[nrow(temp),'event_end']+0.01
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_end']=movie_list[i,2]*100
  
  for (j in 1:(nrow(temp)-1)){ #Construct the remaining non-CE as intervals between CEs
    nonCE[j+1,'event_start']=temp[j,'event_end']+0.01
    nonCE[j+1,'event_end']=temp[j+1,'event_start']-0.01
  }
  
  nonce.list[[i]]=nonCE
}
```

```{r}
nonce.df=rbindlist(nonce.list)
names(nonce.df)[1]="Type"
nonce.df$Type=rep("NonCE",nrow(nonce.df)) #Non-CE df

ce.df=cea.list
names(ce.df)[1]="Type"
ce.df$Type=rep("CE",nrow(ce.df)) #CE df

sdt.ref=rbind(nonce.df,ce.df)
sdt.ref=sdt.ref[order(sdt.ref[,c(2,3)])] #Merging CE/non-CE df
```

```{r}
#remove non-CEs that are wrongly identified due to consecutive CEs
for (i in 1:(nrow(sdt.ref)-1)){
  if (as.numeric(sdt.ref[i,"event_start"])+0.01==as.numeric(sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"])){#if this is a misidentified non-CE row
    sdt.ref[i+1,'removed']="Y" #mark it as Y
  }else{ #otherwise mark it as N
    sdt.ref[i+1,'removed']="N"
  }
}

sdt.ref[1,'removed']="N" #manually specify for the first row

sdt.ref<-sdt.ref %>% filter(removed=="N") #keep only the good rows
sdt.ref <- sdt.ref %>% select(-removed)



for (i in 1:(nrow(sdt.ref)-1)){
  if (sdt.ref[i,"event_end"]==sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"]){
    sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"]=(sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"])+0.01
  }
}

row.names(sdt.ref) <- NULL
```

```{r}
#write.csv(sdt.ref,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_CE_NONCE_list.csv")
chisq.test(table(sdt.ref$Type))
```

##Construct SDT dataframe
```{r}
main.df=main_df 
main.df$timestamp=main.df$timestamp*100
subjID=unique(main.df$subjectID)

vlist = list() 
biglist = list()
```

```{r}
#Find out the CE identified by each subject
for (i in 1:length(subjID)){ 
  d = filter(main.df, subjectID == subjID[i]) #extract all timestamps of subj
  for (j in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
    d.d = filter(d,video == movie_list[j,1]) #extract subject [i]'s timestamps and word for emotion video [j]
    d.d$timestamp=as.numeric(sprintf(d.d$timestamp, fmt = '%#.2f'))
    d.w = filter(sdt.ref, grepl(movie_list[j,1], video)) #filter critical event and windows relevant for emotion video [j]
    d.w$event.n = 1:nrow(d.w) #mark the critical events
    d.w$subjectID=rep(subjID[i],nrow(d.w))
    d.w$Veracity=if_else(d.w$Type=="NonCE",0,1) #NonCE = 0, CE=1
    
    #Locate which CE/non-CE is subject's pause located
    for (m in 1:nrow(d.d)){
      mark=which(d.d[m,'timestamp'] >= d.w$event_start & d.d[m,'timestamp'] <= d.w$event_end)
      d.d[m,'ans_position']=mark
    }
    
    #Record pauses according to positions
    d.w$Answer=if_else(d.w$event.n %in% d.d$ans_position, 1, 0) #Identified = 1, not = 0
    d.w$condition=d$condition[1]
    vlist[[j]] = d.w
  }
  biglist[[i]] = vlist
}

a = do.call(rbind,biglist)
a = do.call(rbind,a) # 180 subj * 147 CE/NON-CE = 26460 obs

combination_counts <- table(sdt.ref$Type, sdt.ref$video)
```

##SDT metrics computation
###1. Aggregation across all videos                                   
```{r}
sdt.agg <- sdt.data %>% 
  mutate(type = "hit") %>% #hit: pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==1 & Answer==0, "miss", type)) %>% #miss: no pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==0, "cr", type)) %>%  #cr: no pause at non-CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==1, "fa", type)) #fa: pause at non-CE
```

```{r}
#Aggregate responses across all videos
sdt.agg.all <- sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
sdt.agg.all

subj=unique(sdt.agg %>% select(c("Participant","condition")))

sdt.agg.all=merge(sdt.agg.all,subj,by="Participant")


```

```{r}
full.sdt.ref <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/full_CE_NONCE_list.csv"))[,-1]
full.acc <- sdt.agg.all %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant,cr,hit) %>%
  mutate(accuracy=(cr+hit)/nrow(full.sdt.ref))
  
```

```{r}
write.csv(full.acc,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_accuracy.csv")
```

```{r}
#Compute dprime and c from aggregated response
sdt.agg.all <- sdt.agg.all %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")
```

```{r}
write.csv(sdt.agg.all,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_SDT_agg_metrics.csv") 
```



###2. Aggregation by each video (Loglinear transformation by each video)
```{r}
#Aggregate response for each video
sdt.agg_v <- sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type, Stimuli) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
sdt.agg_v 

sdt.agg_v <- left_join(sdt.agg_v, subj, by = "Participant")
  
```

```{r}
#Loglinear transformation is used to address null dprime/c due to extreme value of responses (e.g., when hit/fa = 0). To perform the transformation, we first computed the proportion of signal (i.e. CE) and noise (i.e. non-CE), then for all entries add the former value to the number of hits, and the latter value to the number of false alarms.

#Calculate proportion of CE/non-CE
ce.proportion <- sdt.ref %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  spread(Type,count)
ce.proportion$event_sum=rowSums(ce.proportion[2:3],)
ce.proportion=ce.proportion%>%
  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)
```

```{r}
#For each corresponding entries, add % of CE to number of hit and % of non-CE to number of fa.
ce.proportion$video=as.character(ce.proportion$video)
sdt.agg_v_ll=data.frame(sdt.agg_v)
sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli=as.character(sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli)
sdt.agg_v_ll[is.na(sdt.agg_v_ll)]=0
for (i in 1:nrow(sdt.agg_v_ll)){
  mark=which(sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'Stimuli']==ce.proportion$video)
  sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']=sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']+ce.proportion[mark,'CE_per']
  sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']=sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']+ce.proportion[mark,'NCE_per']
}
```

```{r}
#Compute dprime and c using the transformed responses.
sdt.agg.v.ll <- sdt.agg_v_ll %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")

```

```{r}
write.csv(sdt.agg.v.ll,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv") 
```

```{r}
df_summary_by_veracity_2 <- df_summary_by_veracity %>%

  mutate(prop_hit=hit/(hit+miss),prop_miss=miss/(hit+miss),prop_cr=cr/(cr+fa),prop_fa=fa/(cr+fa))

```

```{r}
df_long <- df_summary_by_veracity_3 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(hit, miss, cr, fa),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(prop_hit, prop_miss, prop_cr, prop_fa),
    names_to = "prop_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  # Keep only matching type and prop_type
  filter(
    (type == "hit" & prop_type == "prop_hit") |
    (type == "miss" & prop_type == "prop_miss") |
    (type == "cr" & prop_type == "prop_cr") |
    (type == "fa" & prop_type == "prop_fa")
  ) %>%
  select(-prop_type)
df_long <- na.omit(df_long)
```

#Optimal deviation (using number of events)

##compute target probability for each video

```{r}
#using number of CE/nonCE rather than time
sdt.ref <- read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/full_CE_NONCE_list.csv")

#Calculate proportion of CE/non-CE
ce.proportion <- sdt.ref %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  spread(Type,count)
ce.proportion$event_sum <- rowSums(ce.proportion[2:3],)
ce.proportion <- ce.proportion%>%
  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)

ce.proportion$video <- as.character(ce.proportion$video)

```

```{r}
ce.proportion$beta_opt_number <- (ce.proportion$NCE_per/ce.proportion$CE_per)*((1-(-1))/((1-(-1)))) #assuming j/h=1, a/m=-1
```

```{r}
write.csv(ce.proportion,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_opt_beta_bynumber.csv")
```



##compute optimal criterion and c for each individual

```{r}
# time.beta <- duration_wide %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_time)
# time.beta$video=as.character(time.beta$video)
number.beta <- ce.proportion %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_number)
number.beta$video=as.character(number.beta$video)
opt.beta <- number.beta
```

```{r}
sdt.metrics <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/full_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv"))

sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics %>% dplyr::select(Participant,condition,Stimuli,dprime,c) #select relevant rows
sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics.sub %>% dplyr::rename(video = Stimuli)
sdt.metrics.sub$video <- as.character(sdt.metrics.sub$video)
sdt.metrics.sub <- left_join(sdt.metrics.sub,opt.beta)
```

```{r}
#compute optimal criterion
# sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE number

#compute optimal c

# sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE number


sdt.metrics.sub$c_deviation<- sdt.metrics.sub$c - sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number
```


```{r}
write.csv(sdt.metrics.sub,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_opt_metrics_byvideo.csv")
```

#within group robustness check

#Lab only
##Construct CE/NON-CE list
```{r}
lab.cea.list=read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/LAB_CEA_Windows.csv")
lab.cea.list=lab.cea.list[,-c(1,5)]
lab.cea.list=lab.cea.list %>%
  mutate(CE_number=1:nrow(lab.cea.list))
lab.cea.list=lab.cea.list[,c(4,3,1,2)]

movie_list=data.frame(unique(lab.cea.list$video))#Make a reference list of videos
names(movie_list)[1]="video"
movie_list$length=c(124,78,68,95,75,112,67,167,92) #+1s to accommodate last second pause
```

```{r}
#Construct non-CE events as the interval between two CEs
lab.nonce.list=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
  temp=lab.cea.list %>% filter(video==movie_list[i,1]) #Select video
  nonCE=data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(temp)+1,ncol=4))
  names(nonCE)=c("nonCE_number","video","event_start","event_end")
  nonCE$nonCE_number=c(1:nrow(nonCE))
  nonCE$video=rep(movie_list[i,1],nrow(nonCE))
  
  #The first non-CE event (0 - first CE)
  nonCE[1,'event_start']=0
  nonCE[1,'event_end']=temp[1,'event_start']-0.01
  
  #The last non-CE event (last CE - end)
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_start']=temp[nrow(temp),'event_end']+0.01
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_end']=movie_list[i,2]*100
  
  for (j in 1:(nrow(temp)-1)){ #Construct the remaining non-CE as intervals between CEs
    nonCE[j+1,'event_start']=temp[j,'event_end']+0.01
    nonCE[j+1,'event_end']=temp[j+1,'event_start']-0.01
  }
  
  lab.nonce.list[[i]]=nonCE
}
```


```{r}
  }
}
```

##Construct SDT dataframe
```{r}
lab.main.df=main_df %>% filter(condition=="WithLabel")
lab.main.df$timestamp=lab.main.df$timestamp*100
lab.subjID=unique(lab.main.df$subjectID)

vlist = list() 
biglist = list()
```

```{r}
#Find out the CE identified by each subject
for (i in 1:length(lab.subjID)){ 
  d = filter(lab.main.df, subjectID == lab.subjID[i]) #extract all timestamps of subj
  for (j in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
    d.d = filter(d,video == movie_list[j,1]) #extract subject [i]'s timestamps and word for emotion video [j]
    d.d$timestamp=as.numeric(sprintf(d.d$timestamp, fmt = '%#.2f'))
    d.w = filter(lab.sdt.ref, grepl(movie_list[j,1], video)) #filter critical event and windows relevant for emotion video [j]
    d.w$event.n = 1:nrow(d.w) #mark the critical events
    d.w$subjectID=rep(lab.subjID[i],nrow(d.w))
    d.w$Veracity=if_else(d.w$Type=="NonCE",0,1) #NonCE = 0, CE=1
    
    #Locate which CE/non-CE is subject's pause located
    for (m in 1:nrow(d.d)){
      mark=which(d.d[m,'timestamp'] >= d.w$event_start & d.d[m,'timestamp'] <= d.w$event_end)
      d.d[m,'ans_position']=mark
    }
    
    #Record pauses according to positions
    d.w$Answer=if_else(d.w$event.n %in% d.d$ans_position, 1, 0) #Identified = 1, not = 0
    
    vlist[[j]] = d.w
  }
  biglist[[i]] = vlist
}

a = do.call(rbind,biglist)
a = do.call(rbind,a)
```

##SDT metrics computation
###1. Aggregation across all videos                                   
```{r}
lab.sdt.agg <- lab.sdt.data %>% 
  mutate(type = "hit") %>% #hit: pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==1 & Answer==0, "miss", type)) %>% #miss: no pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==0, "cr", type)) %>%  #cr: no pause at non-CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==1, "fa", type)) #fa: pause at non-CE
```

```{r}
#Aggregate responses across all videos
lab.sdt.agg.all <- lab.sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
lab.sdt.agg.all
```

```{r}
lab.sdt.ref <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/lab_CE_NONCE_list.csv"))[,-1]
lab.acc <- lab.sdt.agg.all %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant,cr,hit) %>%
  mutate(accuracy=(cr+hit)/nrow(lab.sdt.ref))
  
```

```{r}
write.csv(lab.acc,"Processed Data/Level1_output/lab_accuracy.csv")
```

```{r}
#Compute dprime and c from aggregated response
lab.sdt.agg.all <- lab.sdt.agg.all %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")
lab.sdt.agg.all$condition="WithLabel"
```

```{r}
write.csv(lab.sdt.agg.all,"Processed Data/Level1_output/LAB_SDT_agg_metrics.csv") 
```




###2. Aggregation by each video (Loglinear transformation by each video)
```{r}
#Aggregate response for each video
lab.sdt.agg_v <- lab.sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type, Stimuli) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
lab.sdt.agg_v 
```

```{r}
#Loglinear transformation is used to address null dprime/c due to extreme value of responses (e.g., when hit/fa = 0). To perform the transformation, we first computed the proportion of signal (i.e. CE) and noise (i.e. non-CE), then for all entries add the former value to the number of hits, and the latter value to the number of false alarms.

#Calculate proportion of CE/non-CE
lab.ce.proportion <- lab.sdt.ref %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  spread(Type,count)
lab.ce.proportion$event_sum=rowSums(lab.ce.proportion[2:3],)
lab.ce.proportion=lab.ce.proportion%>%
  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)

lab.ce.proportion$video=as.character(lab.ce.proportion$video)
```

```{r}
#For each corresponding entries, add % of CE to number of hit and % of non-CE to number of fa.
lab.ce.proportion$video=as.character(lab.ce.proportion$video)
lab.sdt.agg_v_ll=data.frame(lab.sdt.agg_v)
lab.sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli=as.character(lab.sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli)
lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[is.na(lab.sdt.agg_v_ll)]=0
for (i in 1:nrow(lab.sdt.agg_v_ll)){
  mark=which(lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'Stimuli']==lab.ce.proportion$video)
  lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']=lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']+lab.ce.proportion[mark,'CE_per']
  lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']=lab.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']+lab.ce.proportion[mark,'NCE_per']
}
```

```{r}
#Compute dprime and c using the transformed responses.
lab.sdt.agg.v.ll <- lab.sdt.agg_v_ll %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")
```

```{r}
write.csv(lab.sdt.agg.v.ll,"Processed Data/Level1_output/LAB_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv") 
```

```{r}
movie_list=data.frame(unique(seg.cea.list$video))#Make a reference list of videos
names(movie_list)[1]="video"
movie_list$length=c(124,78,68,95,75,112,67,167,92) #+1s to accommodate last second pause
```

```{r}
#Construct non-CE events as the interval between two CEs
seg.nonce.list=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
  temp=seg.cea.list %>% filter(video==movie_list[i,1]) #Select video
  nonCE=data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(temp)+1,ncol=4))
  names(nonCE)=c("nonCE_number","video","event_start","event_end")
  nonCE$nonCE_number=c(1:nrow(nonCE))
  nonCE$video=rep(movie_list[i,1],nrow(nonCE))
  
  #The first non-CE event (0 - first CE)
  nonCE[1,'event_start']=0
  nonCE[1,'event_end']=temp[1,'event_start']-0.01
  
  #The last non-CE event (last CE - end)
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_start']=temp[nrow(temp),'event_end']+0.01
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_end']=movie_list[i,2]*100
  
  for (j in 1:(nrow(temp)-1)){ #Construct the remaining non-CE as intervals between CEs
    nonCE[j+1,'event_start']=temp[j,'event_end']+0.01
    nonCE[j+1,'event_end']=temp[j+1,'event_start']-0.01
  }
  
  seg.nonce.list[[i]]=nonCE
}
```

#Count only
##Construct CE/NON-CE list
```{r}
count.cea.list=read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_CEA_Windows.csv")
count.cea.list=count.cea.list[,-c(1,5)]
count.cea.list=count.cea.list %>%
  mutate(CE_number=1:nrow(count.cea.list))
count.cea.list=count.cea.list[,c(4,3,1,2)]

movie_list=data.frame(unique(count.cea.list$video))#Make a reference list of videos
names(movie_list)[1]="video"
movie_list$length=c(124,78,68,95,75,112,67,167,92) #+1s to accommodate last second pause
```

```{r}
#Construct non-CE events as the interval between two CEs
count.nonce.list=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
  temp=count.cea.list %>% filter(video==movie_list[i,1]) #Select video
  nonCE=data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(temp)+1,ncol=4))
  names(nonCE)=c("nonCE_number","video","event_start","event_end")
  nonCE$nonCE_number=c(1:nrow(nonCE))
  nonCE$video=rep(movie_list[i,1],nrow(nonCE))
  
  #The first non-CE event (0 - first CE)
  nonCE[1,'event_start']=0
  nonCE[1,'event_end']=temp[1,'event_start']-0.01
  
  #The last non-CE event (last CE - end)
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_start']=temp[nrow(temp),'event_end']+0.01
  nonCE[nrow(nonCE),'event_end']=movie_list[i,2]*100
  
  for (j in 1:(nrow(temp)-1)){ #Construct the remaining non-CE as intervals between CEs
    nonCE[j+1,'event_start']=temp[j,'event_end']+0.01
    nonCE[j+1,'event_end']=temp[j+1,'event_start']-0.01
  }
  
  count.nonce.list[[i]]=nonCE
}
```

```{r}
count.nonce.df=rbindlist(count.nonce.list)
names(count.nonce.df)[1]="Type"
count.nonce.df$Type=rep("NonCE",nrow(count.nonce.df)) #Non-CE df

count.ce.df=count.cea.list
names(count.ce.df)[1]="Type"
count.ce.df$Type=rep("CE",nrow(count.ce.df)) #CE df

count.sdt.ref=rbind(count.nonce.df,count.ce.df)
count.sdt.ref=count.sdt.ref[order(count.sdt.ref[,c(2,3)])] #Merging CE/non-CE df
```

```{r}
#remove non-CEs that are wrongly identified due to consecutive CEs
for (i in 1:(nrow(count.sdt.ref)-1)){
  if (as.numeric(count.sdt.ref[i,"event_start"])+0.01==as.numeric(count.sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"])){#if this is a misidentified non-CE row
    count.sdt.ref[i+1,'removed']="Y" #mark it as Y
  }else{ #otherwise mark it as N
    count.sdt.ref[i+1,'removed']="N"
  }
}

count.sdt.ref[1,'removed']="N" #manually specify for the first row

count.sdt.ref<-count.sdt.ref %>% filter(removed=="N") #keep only the good rows
count.sdt.ref <- count.sdt.ref %>% select(-removed)



for (i in 1:(nrow(count.sdt.ref)-1)){
  if (count.sdt.ref[i,"event_end"]==count.sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"]){
    count.sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"]=(count.sdt.ref[i+1,"event_start"])+0.01
  }
}

row.names(count.sdt.ref) <- NULL
```

```{r}
write.csv(count.sdt.ref,"Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_CE_NONCE_list.csv")
```


##Construct SDT dataframe
```{r}
count.main.df=main_df %>% filter(condition=="Counting")
count.main.df$timestamp=count.main.df$timestamp*100
count.subjID=unique(count.main.df$subjectID)

vlist = list() 
biglist = list()
```

```{r}
#Find out the CE identified by each subject
for (i in 1:length(count.subjID)){ 
  d = filter(count.main.df, subjectID == count.subjID[i]) #extract all timestamps of subj
  for (j in 1:nrow(movie_list)){
    d.d = filter(d,video == movie_list[j,1]) #extract subject [i]'s timestamps and word for emotion video [j]
    d.d$timestamp=as.numeric(sprintf(d.d$timestamp, fmt = '%#.2f'))
    d.w = filter(count.sdt.ref, grepl(movie_list[j,1], video)) #filter critical event and windows relevant for emotion video [j]
    d.w$event.n = 1:nrow(d.w) #mark the critical events
    d.w$subjectID=rep(count.subjID[i],nrow(d.w))
    d.w$Veracity=if_else(d.w$Type=="NonCE",0,1) #NonCE = 0, CE=1
    
    #Locate which CE/non-CE is subject's pause located
    for (m in 1:nrow(d.d)){
      mark=which(d.d[m,'timestamp'] >= d.w$event_start & d.d[m,'timestamp'] <= d.w$event_end)
      d.d[m,'ans_position']=mark
    }
    
    #Record pauses according to positions
    d.w$Answer=if_else(d.w$event.n %in% d.d$ans_position, 1, 0) #Identified = 1, not = 0
    
    vlist[[j]] = d.w
  }
  biglist[[i]] = vlist
}

a = do.call(rbind,biglist)
a = do.call(rbind,a)
```

##SDT metrics computation
###1. Aggregation across all videos                                   
```{r}
count.sdt.agg <- count.sdt.data %>% 
  mutate(type = "hit") %>% #hit: pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==1 & Answer==0, "miss", type)) %>% #miss: no pause at CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==0, "cr", type)) %>%  #cr: no pause at non-CE
  mutate(type = ifelse(Veracity==0 & Answer==1, "fa", type)) #fa: pause at non-CE
```

```{r}
#Aggregate responses across all videos
count.sdt.agg.all <- count.sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
count.sdt.agg.all
```


```{r}
count.sdt.ref <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_CE_NONCE_list.csv"))[,-1]
count.acc <- count.sdt.agg.all %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant,cr,hit) %>%
  mutate(accuracy=(cr+hit)/nrow(count.sdt.ref))
  
```

```{r}
write.csv(count.acc,"Processed Data/Level1_output/count_accuracy.csv")
```


```{r}
#Compute dprime and c from aggregated response
count.sdt.agg.all <- count.sdt.agg.all %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")
count.sdt.agg.all$condition="Counting"
```

```{r}
write.csv(count.sdt.agg.all,"Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_SDT_agg_metrics.csv") 
```


###2. Aggregation by each video (Loglinear transformation by each video)
```{r}
#Aggregate response for each video
count.sdt.agg_v <- count.sdt.agg %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Participant, type, Stimuli) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(type, count)
count.sdt.agg_v 
```

```{r}
#Loglinear transformation is used to address null dprime/c due to extreme value of responses (e.g., when hit/fa = 0). To perform the transformation, we first computed the proportion of signal (i.e. CE) and noise (i.e. non-CE), then for all entries add the former value to the number of hits, and the latter value to the number of false alarms.

#Calculate proportion of CE/non-CE
count.ce.proportion <- count.sdt.ref %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  spread(Type,count)
count.ce.proportion$event_sum=rowSums(count.ce.proportion[2:3],)
count.ce.proportion=count.ce.proportion%>%
  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)

count.ce.proportion$video=as.character(count.ce.proportion$video)
```

```{r}
#For each corresponding entries, add % of CE to number of hit and % of non-CE to number of fa.
count.ce.proportion$video=as.character(count.ce.proportion$video)
count.sdt.agg_v_ll=data.frame(count.sdt.agg_v)
count.sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli=as.character(count.sdt.agg_v_ll$Stimuli)
count.sdt.agg_v_ll[is.na(count.sdt.agg_v_ll)]=0
for (i in 1:nrow(count.sdt.agg_v_ll)){
  mark=which(count.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'Stimuli']==count.ce.proportion$video)
  count.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']=count.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'hit']+count.ce.proportion[mark,'CE_per']
  count.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']=count.sdt.agg_v_ll[i,'fa']+count.ce.proportion[mark,'NCE_per']
}
```

```{r}
#Compute dprime and c using the transformed responses.
count.sdt.agg.v.ll <- count.sdt.agg_v_ll %>% 
  mutate(hr = hit / (hit+miss),
         far = fa / (fa+cr),
         zhr = qnorm(hr),
         zfa = qnorm(far),
         dprime = zhr-zfa,
         c = -0.5*(zhr+zfa),
         beta=exp(-0.5*(zhr*zhr-zfa*zfa)),
         model = "no pooling")
```

```{r}
write.csv(count.sdt.agg.v.ll,"Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv") 
```

##compute target probability for each video

```{r}
#using number of CE/nonCE rather than time

  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>%

  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)

ce.proportion$video <- as.character(ce.proportion$video)

```

```{r}
ce.proportion$beta_opt_number <- (ce.proportion$NCE_per/ce.proportion$CE_per)*((1-(-1))/((1-(-1)))) #assuming j/h=1, a/m=-1
```

##compute optimal criterion and c for each individual

```{r}
# time.beta <- duration_wide %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_time)
# time.beta$video=as.character(time.beta$video)
number.beta <- ce.proportion %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_number)
number.beta$video=as.character(number.beta$video)
opt.beta <- number.beta
```

```{r}
sdt.metrics <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/lab_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv"))

sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics %>% dplyr::select(Participant,Stimuli,dprime,c) #select relevant rows
sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics.sub %>% dplyr::rename(video = Stimuli)
sdt.metrics.sub$video <- as.character(sdt.metrics.sub$video)
sdt.metrics.sub <- left_join(sdt.metrics.sub,opt.beta)
```

```{r}
#compute optimal criterion
# sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE number

#compute optimal c

# sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE number


sdt.metrics.sub$c_deviation<- sdt.metrics.sub$c - sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number
```

```{r}
#compute optimal criterion
# sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$criterion_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime) + (sdt.metrics.sub$dprime / 2) #using CE number

#compute optimal c

# sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_time <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_time) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE time proportion

sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number <- (log(sdt.metrics.sub$beta_opt_number) / sdt.metrics.sub$dprime)  #using CE number


sdt.metrics.sub$c_deviation<- sdt.metrics.sub$c - sdt.metrics.sub$c_opt_number
```

```{r}
sdt.metrics.sub$condition="NoLabel"
write.csv(sdt.metrics.sub,"Processed Data/Level1_output/seg_opt_metrics_byvideo.csv")
```

#counting
##compute target probability for each video

```{r}
#using number of CE/nonCE rather than time
sdt.ref <- read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_CE_NONCE_list.csv")

#Calculate proportion of CE/non-CE
ce.proportion <- sdt.ref %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(video, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  spread(Type,count)
ce.proportion$event_sum <- rowSums(ce.proportion[2:3],)
ce.proportion <- ce.proportion%>%
  mutate(CE_per=CE/event_sum,NCE_per=NonCE/event_sum)

ce.proportion$video <- as.character(ce.proportion$video)

```

```{r}
ce.proportion$beta_opt_number <- (ce.proportion$NCE_per/ce.proportion$CE_per)*((1-(-1))/((1-(-1)))) #assuming j/h=1, a/m=-1
```

```{r}
write.csv(ce.proportion,"Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_opt_beta_bynumber.csv")
```



##compute optimal criterion and c for each individual

```{r}
# time.beta <- duration_wide %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_time)
# time.beta$video=as.character(time.beta$video)
number.beta <- ce.proportion %>% dplyr::select(video,beta_opt_number)
number.beta$video=as.character(number.beta$video)
opt.beta <- number.beta
```

```{r}
sdt.metrics <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/COUNT_LL_SDT_byvideo_metrics.csv"))

sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics %>% dplyr::select(Participant,Stimuli,dprime,c) #select relevant rows
sdt.metrics.sub <- sdt.metrics.sub %>% dplyr::rename(video = Stimuli)
sdt.metrics.sub$video <- as.character(sdt.metrics.sub$video)
sdt.metrics.sub <- left_join(sdt.metrics.sub,opt.beta)
```

